introduction.zh: 把同一幅抽象图当作整体、追一个边缘、想象动势、比较色块，或临时编想场景，你此刻更想选哪一种？本版提供十张费马独立创作的对称SVG墨迹，每图一题、四种说法，旁有中性结构说明。它不是心理学家使用的Rorschach测试，不采用历史牌卡或CS、R-PAS临床编码，也不从图像选择解释人格、无意识、共情或职业。全部十题后看相对次数与所有最高并列；五份完整说明也可直接先读，无需注册或另做测评解锁。
introduction.en: Would you rather read an abstract image as a whole, follow an edge, imagine movement, compare regions or develop a temporary scene? This edition offers ten independently authored symmetrical SVG blots, one question per image and four offered readings, with neutral structural descriptions. It is not the professional Rorschach assessment, uses no historical plates or CS or R-PAS clinical codes, and infers no personality, unconscious content, empathy or career. Complete ten choices for relative counts and every highest tie, or read all five full guides first without signup or another assessment.

instructions.zh: 看十张费马原创抽象墨迹图，每张从四种说法中选此刻更想沿着看的方式。图旁有中性结构说明；不要求看到特定物体，也不测最先看到什么、速度、眼动或隐藏人格。五种编辑阅读焦点各出现8次，在四个位置各2次；每选一项加1，0反向。完整十题后保留全部最高并列，不硬派主副型或百分比。没有贴切选项时可退出并直接读全部五份公开说明，不把未完成解释成问题。图像加载失败时不能继续计分。
instructions.en: Look at ten independently authored abstract blots and choose the offered way of looking you currently prefer. Neutral structural descriptions accompany the images. No particular object is required and neither first perception, speed, eye movements nor hidden personality is measured. Five editorial reading focuses each appear eight times and twice in each position. Every choice adds one count with no reverse keys. Complete ten choices for every highest tie without a forced secondary type or percentage. If no option fits, you may leave and read all five public guides; an unfinished attempt establishes no problem. Image loading failure prevents continued scoring.

headline.zh: 原创墨迹选项中的趣味读法，不是人格或临床结论。
headline.en: A playful reading of original blot options rather than a personality or clinical conclusion.

summary.zh: 本次较常选择先看整体外形、两侧对应与白色间隔。它描述这组墨迹选项的阅读偏好，不测分析能力、秩序人格或职业。
summary.en: Your choices more often favoured overall outlines, mirrored relationships and white spaces. This describes reading preferences in this set, not analysis skill, an orderly personality or career.

scoreReading.zh: 十题各选一项，对应阅读焦点加1，次数合计10。每题提供五种焦点中的四种；各焦点在全卷出现8次，在四个位置各2次。没出现的另一项不记为被拒绝，分母8只是选项曝光次数，不是看图能力、相似度百分比或人格强度。所有最高计数保留全文；全选同一位置会五类各2，五份全部呈现，名单顺序不设主副型。相差一次只是一道选择，不证明显著差异、稳定类型、稀有度或人群排名。近分可一起读，不造没有并列的混合人格。图像、结构文字、屏幕条件与措辞都可能影响选择；这不是独立的视力、第一反应或认知测量。
scoreReading.en: Choose one option in each of ten questions; every choice adds one count and the total is ten. Each question offers four of five focuses. Every focus appears eight times and twice in each position. The absent focus is not rejected, and eight is an exposure denominator rather than an ability score, similarity percentage or personality intensity. Every highest count retains its full guide. Choosing the same position throughout gives two each and displays all five without list-order primary or secondary types. A one-choice gap establishes no significant difference, stable type, rarity or population rank. Read close guides without inventing an untied hybrid personality. Images, descriptions, display conditions and wording may affect choices; this is no independent vision, first-response or cognitive measure.

title.zh: 墨迹测试整体轮廓结果：例子与完整说明
title.en: Whole-form Inkblot Result: Examples & Full Guide

description.zh: 本次较常选择先看整体外形、两侧对应与白色间隔。它描述这组墨迹选项的阅读偏好，不测分析能力、秩序人格或职业。
description.en: Explore whole-form reading through original blots, examples and four comparisons. Full results without personality, analytical skill or career claims.

title.zh: 把局部放回同一画面
title.en: Placing parts in one arrangement

paragraphs.zh: 整体轮廓把注意放在这张图怎样占据纸面：左右是分开的还是连起来，宽高怎样，白色间隔与深色部分如何共同构成外形。它不是要求看出一个正确物体，也不意味着你总能把握全局。题目只让你在四个说法中选更想沿着看的方式，没有记录视线、反应时间或实际最先注意的地方。名称是本次读法的简称，不是一种稳定人格。
paragraphs.en: Whole-form Reading concerns how an image occupies its space: whether sides separate or join, their width and height, and how white gaps participate in the arrangement. It requires no correct object and establishes no general ability to grasp a bigger picture. You chose an offered way to continue looking; the quiz recorded neither gaze nor reaction time or what actually attracted attention first. The name abbreviates a reading in this set rather than a stable personality.

title.zh: 用第一张图说明
title.en: An example from the first image

paragraphs.zh: 第一张原创图有两块分开的深青色竖形，内侧浅绿，中间留白。沿整体轮廓看，可以先把左右当成一组，注意中间白隙的宽度，再看这组形与白底的关系。另一个人可能更喜欢上缘的小点，两种选择都成立。你不必把图认成蝴蝶、面孔或任何对象，图上也没有藏着能判定谁正常、谁更理性的标准答案。
paragraphs.en: The first original image has two separated dark-teal vertical forms, pale-green interiors and a central white gap. An overall reading might treat the sides as a pair, notice the gap’s width and consider the pair against the white ground. Someone else may prefer the little upper dots. Neither choice needs a butterfly, face or other recognised object, and the image contains no hidden answer establishing normality or greater rationality.

title.zh: 怎样把计数读窄
title.en: Keeping the count interpretation narrow

paragraphs.zh: 最高计数只表示你在这些图片和措辞中较常选了整体读法。因为每题另外一项没有出现，没选局部也不等于拒绝细节；选整体更不代表能看出系统哪里会失灵。图片的颜色、尺度、显示清晰度和中性结构文字都可能影响选择。结果不能从十次点击推断注意机制、大脑默认模式、内外向、尽责性、共情或实际工作表现。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means the offered whole-form readings appealed more often with these images and words. One focus is absent from each question, and not selecting a detail establishes no rejection of detail. Choosing an overall view proves no ability to locate a failing system. Colour, scale, display clarity and structural descriptions may affect choices. Ten clicks cannot establish attention mechanisms, a brain default, introversion, conscientiousness, empathy or work performance.

title.zh: 把偏好说成一种看图方式
title.en: Describing a way to view an image

paragraphs.zh: 如果和朋友看同一张原创图，可以说“我现在想先看左右与中间空白形成的整体”，然后听听对方想看哪里。你不需要替对方解释为什么看到不同东西，也不应把图当测谎或识人的办法。这个说法同样可以用于讨论一张抽象画的构图，但是否喜欢整幅布局，不能证明你在学习、规划或关系里也一定先看全局。
paragraphs.en: With a friend looking at the same original image, you could describe wanting to examine the arrangement of sides and central space, then ask where they want to look. Neither person needs an explanation of the other’s hidden motives, and the image is no device for detecting truth or character. The wording may also help discuss an abstract composition, but liking its overall arrangement establishes no big-picture approach to learning, planning or relationships.

title.zh: 与另外四种读法比较
title.en: Comparing the other four readings

paragraphs.zh: 边缘细节把注意放在一个凸起、凹口或小点；整体轮廓把这些部分放回同一布局。动势联想想象静止形状怎样展开或转动，色块对照看深浅与不同色区，场景编想为形状临时构想画面。它们能在看同一张图时先后发生，不构成理性对感性或细心对粗心的分组。最高并列保留全部全文，不据此造主副人格、互补搭档或MBTI对应。
paragraphs.en: Edge-detail Reading follows a projection, notch or dot, while Whole-form Reading places parts in a single arrangement. Motion Association imagines unfolding or turning, Contrast Noticing compares darker and paler areas, and Scene Imagining develops a temporary picture. They can occur in sequence with one image rather than forming rational-versus-emotional or careful-versus-careless groups. Every highest tie retains its guide without creating primary and secondary personalities, complementary partners or MBTI equivalents.

title.zh: 今天想看细节也不矛盾
title.en: Wanting details today need not conflict

paragraphs.zh: 你可能在第一张图喜欢看整体，在第七张却只想沿中间白隙追一个小弯折；也可能只是某个选项描述得更具体。这样的差别不需要用“我其实是另一型”来修补。低计数不证明缺少结构感，高计数不证明更可靠、适合审计或擅长工程。图像与文字共同组成这份趣味选择，不能把它们拆掉以后仍宣称测到了普遍的感知能力。
paragraphs.en: You may prefer the first image’s whole arrangement but follow one bend beside the seventh image’s white gap, or simply find an option more concrete. That needs no repair through another type label. Lower counts establish no missing sense of structure; higher ones certify neither reliability nor suitability for audit or engineering. Images and wording jointly form this playful choice set, not a general perceptual capacity that remains established after removing them.

title.zh: 可选的一次画面描述
title.en: An optional description

paragraphs.zh: 若愿意，重新看一张公开原创图，用一句话描述整体布局，再用一句话描述一个细节；你也可以只看，不写。没有训练目标、正确答案或必须变得更全面的任务。不要把自己的描述拿来评估别人，更不必寻找私人记忆解释它。这个小观察只帮助区分你此刻想怎样谈论一张图，不承诺提升注意力、认知能力、情绪或人格。
paragraphs.en: If you wish, revisit an original image and describe its arrangement in one sentence and a detail in another, or simply look without writing. There is no training target, correct answer or assignment to become more comprehensive. Use no description to assess another person and search for no private memory to explain it. This optional observation distinguishes how you want to discuss an image now, without promises about attention, cognition, mood or personality.

title.zh: 十题计数、全部最高并列与近分
title.en: Ten-item counts, every highest tie and close results

paragraphs.zh: 十题各选一项，对应阅读焦点加1，次数合计10。每题提供五种焦点中的四种；各焦点在全卷出现8次，在四个位置各2次。没出现的另一项不记为被拒绝，分母8只是选项曝光次数，不是看图能力、相似度百分比或人格强度。所有最高计数保留全文；全选同一位置会五类各2，五份全部呈现，名单顺序不设主副型。相差一次只是一道选择，不证明显著差异、稳定类型、稀有度或人群排名。近分可一起读，不造没有并列的混合人格。图像、结构文字、屏幕条件与措辞都可能影响选择；这不是独立的视力、第一反应或认知测量。
paragraphs.en: Choose one option in each of ten questions; every choice adds one count and the total is ten. Each question offers four of five focuses. Every focus appears eight times and twice in each position. The absent focus is not rejected, and eight is an exposure denominator rather than an ability score, similarity percentage or personality intensity. Every highest count retains its full guide. Choosing the same position throughout gives two each and displays all five without list-order primary or secondary types. A one-choice gap establishes no significant difference, stable type, rarity or population rank. Read close guides without inventing an untied hybrid personality. Images, descriptions, display conditions and wording may affect choices; this is no independent vision, first-response or cognitive measure.

title.zh: 原创图像与专业方法的边界
title.en: Original images and the professional-method boundary

paragraphs.zh: 本版是十张独立原创SVG与十道原创限定选项的趣味阅读，不是心理学家使用的Rorschach测试，不提供CS、R-PAS实施、编码或诊断。五类只描述本组选项中想沿着看的方式，不测神经机制、共情、创造力、视觉或认知能力、稳定人格、健康、职业或MBTI大五HSP等其他框架。没有采用历史牌卡、官方标准图像、临床常模、标准系统题本或竞品图文人设。Rorschach名称仅用于说明墨迹联想的背景，非官方产品或背书；正式方法的研究不验证这些图像、选项、计数或解释。中性结构文字与屏幕条件可能影响选择，不把结果当视觉检查。
paragraphs.en: This is a playful reading of ten independently authored SVGs and ten original bounded choices, not the Rorschach assessment used by psychologists or CS or R-PAS administration, coding or diagnosis. Five labels describe offered ways you prefer to explore, not neural mechanisms, empathy, creativity, visual or cognitive ability, stable personality, health, career or MBTI, Big Five, HSP and other frameworks. No historical plates, official standard images, clinical norms, standard banks or competitor art, prose or personas are used. Rorschach names the background of inkblot association rather than an official product or endorsement. Research on professional methods validates neither these images, options, counts nor interpretations. Structural descriptions and screen conditions may affect choices; results are not a vision examination.

title.zh: 边缘细节：沿一个小变化继续看
title.en: Edge-detail Reading: Following a Small Difference

headline.zh: 原创墨迹选项中的趣味读法，不是人格或临床结论。
headline.en: A playful reading of original blot options rather than a personality or clinical conclusion.

summary.en: Your choices more often followed edge turns, little dots and local gaps. This records choices within these images, not carefulness, eyesight, analysis ability or a stable trait.

title.zh: 墨迹测试边缘细节结果：例子与完整说明
title.en: Edge-detail Inkblot Result: Examples & Full Guide

description.zh: 本次较常选择追随边缘转折、小点和局部间隔。它记录这组图中的阅读选择，不测细心、视力、分析能力或稳定特质。
description.en: Read edge-detail choices through local contours, examples and four comparisons. No eyesight, carefulness, clinical coding or ability verdicts.

title.zh: 细节是一个具体位置
title.en: A detail is a particular place

paragraphs.zh: 边缘细节关注的不是整张图意味着什么，而是某一个可指明的位置：上缘的凸起、内侧白隙的一段弯折、小点与主形之间的距离。你可以看一会儿就停下，不需要找完所有差异。结果没有记录你看得是否准确、多久找到，也没有评视力或专注力。它只是对应本组选项中那些邀请你沿一个局部继续看的说法。
paragraphs.en: Edge-detail Reading concerns an identifiable place rather than what an entire image means: an upper projection, a bend beside a white gap or a dot’s distance from the main form. You may look briefly and stop without finding every difference. No accuracy, search time, eyesight or attention capacity was measured. This result corresponds only to options inviting you to continue looking along a particular part of these images.

title.zh: 用第七张图说明
title.en: An example from the seventh image

paragraphs.zh: 第七张原创图是左右分开的宽紫色形状，中间留下一段折线状白隙。你可以沿其中一边，看看转折怎样改变空白的宽度，再留意附近的浅色内斑。这个观察不需要给墨迹命名，也不说明你比选整体的人看得深。大家得到的是同一张静止图，差别只在此刻更想沿哪个说法看，题目没有验证任何人的真实视觉搜索过程。

title.zh: 次数不是发现细节的成绩
title.en: A count is no detail-detection score

paragraphs.zh: 每选一次边缘说法计数加1，但图上没有预设必须找到几个点或几个凹口。你可能只是喜欢“沿着看”的措辞，也可能因屏幕较清楚而愿意靠近某一处。最高计数不是细节能力的满分，也不表示在真实生活里总能发现问题；低计数同样不能证明粗心。它与临床Rorschach的位置编码不同，不能把本版一个选项拿去套用CS或R-PAS。

You may like the wording about tracing, or a clear display may make one area appealing. A highest count is no maximum detail ability and establishes no habit of finding real-life problems; lower counts establish no carelessness. This differs from professional Rorschach location coding, and a website option cannot be transferred into CS or R-PAS interpretation.

title.zh: 先指出位置，再听不同读法
title.en: Naming the place before hearing alternatives

paragraphs.zh: 可以对同伴说“我现在看的是右边外缘这一小段”，而不是“这说明我是分析型”。对方可能在同处想象运动，或根本没兴趣追边缘，这不需要谁说服谁。即使你平常做事很细，也不由这张图证明；即使工作常看细节，也可以休闲时只想看颜色。把表达留在画面和当下意愿里，比把一项计数迁移到职业、学习或人际能力更稳妥。
paragraphs.en: You could point to a short section of the right edge instead of declaring an analytical type. A companion may imagine movement there or feel no interest in tracing, without either person needing to persuade the other. Everyday carefulness is not proved by the image, and detail-heavy work does not require detail-focused leisure. Keep the wording with the picture and present preference rather than transferring a count into career, learning or interpersonal ability.

title.zh: 与整体、颜色和联想分别读
title.en: Separating arrangement, contrast and associations

paragraphs.zh: 整体轮廓把两侧和白隙看作一组；边缘细节可以只沿其中一小段。色块对照关注深浅和不同颜色的关系，不要求边界更复杂；动势联想为静止图想象展开、靠近或转动；场景编想则临时把形状放进一幅画面。五者不是知觉层级，也不对应五种已验证的人格。差一次只是一道选择，近分可以一起看，不把某项当作需要由其他项弥补的缺陷。

Contrast Noticing concerns relationships among darker, paler or differently coloured areas without needing complex edges. Motion Association imagines unfolding, approaching or turning, while Scene Imagining places forms in a temporary picture. These are neither perceptual levels nor five validated personalities. A one-choice gap establishes no deficit for another focus to compensate; nearby guides can be read together.

title.zh: 不想追一个细节也有理由
title.en: There may be reasons not to follow a detail

paragraphs.zh: 图片缩得小、屏幕不清楚、光线不舒服或你只是没兴趣，都可能让这一项不吸引你。它们不应被解释成认知问题、缺少耐心或不够认真。中性结构说明会指出一些可见位置，也可能影响选择；因此本版并不宣称测到未经提示的第一反应。你可以退出或直接阅读全文，没有必要为了一个结果勉强自己盯图，更不能据此判断别人的健康与能力。
paragraphs.en: Small images, an unclear display, uncomfortable lighting or lack of interest may make this reading unappealing. None should be interpreted as a cognitive problem, impatience or lack of effort. Neutral structural descriptions identify visible places and may influence choices, so this is no unprompted first-response measure. You can leave or read guides without continuing; no result requires prolonged looking, and choices establish nothing about another person’s health or capacity.

title.zh: 给一个局部写清位置
title.en: Locating one part

paragraphs.zh: 若愿意，选一张原创图，只写“哪一侧、靠上还是靠下、哪种边缘变化”，不必解释它代表什么。再看看同一处也能否被描述成色块关系，或选择到此结束。这个小观察没有提高视力、专注或分析能力的承诺，也不是临床训练。你无需记录私人联想、上传画面或分享次数；公开说明和你自己的观看过程可以一直分开。

You might then describe that same area as a colour relationship, or stop. This promises no improvement in eyesight, attention or analysis and is no clinical training. No private associations, uploaded images or shared counts are needed. A public explanation can remain separate from your own experience of looking.

title.zh: 原创图像与专业方法的边界

No historical plates, official standard images, clinical norms, standard banks or competitor art, prose or personas are used. Rorschach names the background of inkblot association rather than an official product or endorsement. Research on professional methods validates neither these images, options, counts nor interpretations. Structural descriptions and screen conditions may affect choices; results are not a vision examination.

description.en: Explore imagined movement in static original blots through full examples and comparisons. No action, energy, neurotype or personality verdicts.

title.zh: 运动来自联想，不来自图像
title.en: Movement is imagined rather than displayed

paragraphs.zh: 这里十张图都是静止的原创墨迹，没有动画、反应速度任务或需要追踪的移动目标。动势联想只是把一个静止轮廓想成可能展开、靠近、转动或收拢的姿态。你可以觉得它有意思，也可以完全不想这样看。选择这种说法不证明真实地看到了运动，更不意味着坐不住、胆大、热爱风险或比别人行动更快。它是本组选项中的阅读名称。
paragraphs.en: All ten images are static original blots, without animation, reaction-speed tasks or moving targets to track. Motion Association imagines a contour unfolding, approaching, turning or gathering. You may enjoy that or feel no interest. paragraphs.en: Higher counts mean the motion-oriented wording appealed more often with these images, not that you act first at work, tolerate chaos or need stimulation. If the name is unhelpful, retain a description you liked without extending it across your life.

description.en: Read colour-region comparisons in original blots with full examples and four comparisons. No colour vision, mood, talent or personality conclusions.

title.zh: 比较的是画面中的关系
title.en: Comparing relationships in the image

paragraphs.zh: 色块对照把两种颜色、深浅或一块内部斑形与外层放在一起看，不需要喜欢其中某一种，也没有哪种颜色代表某种人格。十张原创图使用不同配色，选择可能来自一组颜色恰好合意。题目没有色觉检测、标准照明或视觉校准，不能告诉你看得准不准。结构说明写出颜色与位置，既帮助理解，也可能引导了选择，这一影响应保留在解释里。
paragraphs.en: Contrast Noticing compares colours, darker and paler areas, or inner patches with an exterior without requiring a favourite colour. No colour represents a personality here. title.zh: 用第四张图说明
title.en: An example from the fourth image

title.zh: 颜色选择不等于心理含义

paragraphs.en: A highest count means the colour-comparison wording appealed more often. It explains no liking for purple, teal or brown and infers no mood, aesthetic level, creativity or career interest. Counts describe relative selections among limited options rather than independently measuring stable colour preference or actual visual attention.

title.zh: 把对照说得可以指认

paragraphs.en: With a friend viewing the sixth image, you could name the pale-green middle and surrounding dark teal, then ask what they want to examine. title.zh: 画面可以临时出现，也可以没有
title.en: A scene may appear temporarily, or not at all

paragraphs.zh: 场景编想是在一张抽象图前愿意补出一幅临时画面，而不要求图上真的有某个对象。你可以把形状看成一处入口、两块漂浮的布景或完全没有名字的场面，也可以不这样想。它不是要求讲完整故事、回忆个人经历或展示创造力。题目只记录你较愿意选哪种说法，没有分析自由文本、梦、记忆或无意识内容，更不从画面判断人格。

paragraphs.en: The fifth original image has two separated dark-rose vertical forms with white between them and pale-brown interiors. paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often wanted to place forms into a scene with these images and words. It establishes no greater creativity, writing suitability, understanding of people or MBTI intuition preference. Wording may simply appeal, or an ordinary picture may come to mind today. Without free responses, work evaluation, timing or cognitive assessment, these counts cannot establish a stable narrative ability or the true contents of an inner mind.

paragraphs.en: You can describe using a white gap as an entrance in a little scene while making clear it is your current association. paragraphs.en: Motion Association may involve one turn or unfolding without a scene, while a scene can remain static. paragraphs.en: Sometimes you see regions without wanting to turn them into objects, or a scene option simply fails to fit. title.en: Original images and the professional-method boundary

paragraphs.zh: 本版是十张独立原创SVG与十道原创限定选项的趣味阅读，不是心理学家使用的Rorschach测试，不提供CS、R-PAS实施、编码或诊断。五类只描述本组选项中想沿着看的方式，不测神经机制、共情、创造力、视觉或认知能力、稳定人格、健康、职业或MBTI大五HSP等其他框架。没有采用历史牌卡、官方标准图像、临床常模、标准系统题本或竞品图文人设。Rorschach名称仅用于说明墨迹联想的背景，非官方产品或背书；正式方法的研究不验证这些图像、选项、计数或解释。中性结构文字与屏幕条件可能影响选择，不把结果当视觉检查。
paragraphs.en: This is a playful reading of ten independently authored SVGs and ten original bounded choices, not the Rorschach assessment used by psychologists or CS or R-PAS administration, coding or diagnosis. Five labels describe offered ways you prefer to explore, not neural mechanisms, empathy, creativity, visual or cognitive ability, stable personality, health, career or MBTI, Big Five, HSP and other frameworks. No historical plates, official standard images, clinical norms, standard banks or competitor art, prose or personas are used. Rorschach names the background of inkblot association rather than an official product or endorsement. Research on professional methods validates neither these images, options, counts nor interpretations. Structural descriptions and screen conditions may affect choices; results are not a vision examination.

title.zh: 十张图怎样形成五类计数
title.en: How ten images produce five reading counts

paragraphs.zh: 十题各选一项，对应阅读焦点加1，次数合计10。每题提供五种焦点中的四种；各焦点在全卷出现8次，在四个位置各2次。没出现的另一项不记为被拒绝，分母8只是选项曝光次数，不是看图能力、相似度百分比或人格强度。所有最高计数保留全文；全选同一位置会五类各2，五份全部呈现，名单顺序不设主副型。相差一次只是一道选择，不证明显著差异、稳定类型、稀有度或人群排名。近分可一起读，不造没有并列的混合人格。图像、结构文字、屏幕条件与措辞都可能影响选择；这不是独立的视力、第一反应或认知测量。
paragraphs.en: Choose one option in each of ten questions; every choice adds one count and the total is ten. Each question offers four of five focuses. Every focus appears eight times and twice in each position. The absent focus is not rejected, and eight is an exposure denominator rather than an ability score, similarity percentage or personality intensity. Every highest count retains its full guide. Choosing the same position throughout gives two each and displays all five without list-order primary or secondary types. A one-choice gap establishes no significant difference, stable type, rarity or population rank. Read close guides without inventing an untied hybrid personality. Images, descriptions, display conditions and wording may affect choices; this is no independent vision, first-response or cognitive measure.

title.zh: 五份完整结果与全部最高并列
title.en: Five full guides and every highest tie

paragraphs.zh: 五种读法为整体轮廓、边缘细节、动势联想、色块对照和场景编想。每份正文包含读法定义、原创图例子、计数读法、日常表达、其余四类比较、反例、可选观察、计分和范围。所有最高并列完整呈现，其他说明始终公开。它们不是五种已验证人格或能力，也没有稀有、优劣、主副型或互补搭档结论。
paragraphs.en: The readings are Whole-form, Edge-detail, Motion Association, Contrast Noticing and Scene Imagining. Each full guide includes a definition, an original-image example, count interpretation, possible wording, four comparisons, counterexamples, optional observation, scoring and scope. Every highest tie appears in full, and other guides remain public. These are no validated personalities or abilities, with no rarity, superior type, fixed secondary or complementary-partner claims.

title.zh: 图像与结构说明怎样使用
title.en: Using images and structural descriptions

paragraphs.zh: 图像为本站自写曲线生成的十张原创SVG，全部静止，未使用外部图片、历史牌卡或官方标准素材。每张图都有中性结构说明，描述颜色、左右与空白，不告诉你必须看见某个物体。文字和显示条件可能影响答案，这不是第一反应、眼动或视力测试。图像失败时无法继续计分，可以退出或读公开全文，不用缺失图像的文字冒充已完成视觉流程。
paragraphs.en: Ten original SVGs were drawn with independently written curve generation. All are static and use no external pictures, historical plates or official standard material. Neutral descriptions locate colours, sides and spaces without requiring an object. Wording and viewing conditions may influence answers; this is no first-response, eye-tracking or vision test. Image failure prevents continued scoring. You may leave or read public guides without a text-only substitute being treated as a completed visual flow.
